message: 兄の心妹知らず

name: Synn
message: 「--And so, that's what happened yesterday.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like to submit an application for patrol duty, though.」

name: Helena
message: 「There's really no need for that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm personally granting my approval, so there's no problem at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then what about Sengen'in-sensei yesterday...?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's just the thing.」

name: Helena
message: 「She wasn't even on night duty yesterday, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be that the teacher was also conducting patrols voluntarily?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Getting yelled at by her over that makes zero sense, seriously.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's probably just a really strict and earnest teacher.」

name: Misa
message: 「You mean she spoke harshly on purpose?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That doesn't make me happy in the slightest.」

name: Helena
message: 「Either way, it bothers me...」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll look into that matter on my end.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please do.」

name: Helena
message: 「By the way...」

name: Helena
message: 「Isn't little Macaron with you today?」

name: Synn
message: 「She's probably at her part-time job or doing solo training, I think.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, is that so. What a shame, I was thinking of inviting her to another tea party.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, please don't treat Macaron like a toy too much...」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, I get it already!」

name: Helena
message: 「As her big brother, you just don't like having your adorable little sister stolen away, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I told you, it's nothing like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Saying that with a bright red face isn't exactly convincing, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You do adore your little sister very much, President.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, how jealous I am.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, isn't it totally normal to be worried...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, since it can't be helped, I suppose I'll go get Melilot to comfort me instead.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Please do your work properly.」

name: Helena
message: 「Boo-hoo! I am doing it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh.... Well then, excuse me.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Maybe I'll go for around two thousand practice swings today~」

name: Arden
message: 「I love youuu! Pasta-chaaan!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I hate you, nya! Knock it off already, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hm? What's going on...」

name: Arden
message: 「I'm dead serious here!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「And I'm saying you're a nuisance, nya! Pasta has zero interest in the likes of you, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「Just what could possibly be lacking in a guy as overly perfect as me, Pasta-chan!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Everything, nya. Your very existence is defective, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「Gahaaah!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「What are you two fighting about?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Unya, Macaron...」

name: Pasta
message: 「This stalker won't leave me alone, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「I'm not a stalker! I just wanted to get these feelings across!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Your creepiness got across loud and clear, nya. Just go home already, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「Uooooh, Pasta-chaaan...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Now, now, both of you calm down first.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just leave it to the great Macaron and talk it out with me real quick.」

name: Pasta
message: 「There's nothing to talk about, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「Nugah!? You're that little shit from the other day!」

name: Arden
message: 「So you came back to get in the way of my romance again, huh!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Before anyone could even get in the way, that romance didn't exist in the first place, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Romance...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「In that case, I'll actually cheer you on.」

name: Arden
message: 「What?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya!? What are you saying, nya, Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean, Arden-san likes Pasta-chan, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Falling for someone is a wonderful thing.」

name: Arden
message: 「Right?!」

name: Arden
message: 「Man! You're a pretty understanding squirt after all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aahn, geez, hey, stop grinding your knuckles into my head!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Grr... Betrayal at a time like this, nya...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not betraying you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Pasta-chan, do you hate Arden-san?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I HATE him, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Like I've said over and over, I despise him from the bottom of my heart, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, really... That's a problem...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Listen up, nya, the one Pasta holds feelings for is Bylous-nyama-nyama and him alone, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eh, Bylous...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Compared to the strong and handsome Bylous-nyama-nya, an idiot like Arden might as well not even exist, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「Guoooh! Bylous again, dammit!」

name: Arden
message: 「But! No matter how many times you dump me, I won't give up!」

name: Arden
message: 「Pasta-chaaan! I love youuu!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「What are you blabbering about while running away with your tail between your legs, nya...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, I think Arden-san is amazing.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Being able to tell the person you love that you love them so honestly.」

name: Pasta
message: 「He's just stupid, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, that might be true too.」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Do you have someone you like too, Macaron, nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ueh!? I-I don't really have anyone like that...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Hmm... Is that so, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, more importantly, Pasta-chan.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You mentioned Lord Bylous earlier, right...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya? Did something happen to my beloved Bylous-nyama-nya, nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Could it be that you happen to know where he is?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Of course, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Really!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I can't tell you, though, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Bylous-nyama-nya is currently gathering his strength to prepare for his showdown with the Demon Lord, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「I won't let anyone get in his way, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yes, that's it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I want to have a showdown with Bylous-san!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Unya? But you're not even a proper Demon Lord yet, nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, yeah, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can't move forward unless I have a match with Bylous-san.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I know for sure that doing so will bring me closer to the true Demon Lord.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Is that how it works, nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. The Demon Lord doesn't lie!」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Got it, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'll try asking Master Bylous-nya once, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Thanks, Pasta-chan.」

name: Pasta
message: 「But... Master Bylous-nya is really strong, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta won't take responsibility no matter what happens, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's fine, it's fine! Things'll work out somehow!」
